serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Come on girl, not everyone is fit to be a nun.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Uhh… She didn’t take it well.
You: It’s not a reason to be sad. Cheer up!
I wanted to say “grow up’ at the end, but that would be a little overboard. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
Sexy nun: I-I’m not sad! 
Sexy nun: Maybe I was a little bit dejected, but I wouldn’t be sad because of words from someone like you!
You: Wha?! And what is that supposed to mean?!
Sexy nun: I don’t know! You are just being rude and your skin has a weird color.
My skin has a weird color?! 
Sexy nun: Like, seriously! Get some tan or just go outside more!
You: Why are you insulting me?! I just gave my honest opinion! Maybe you should change your attitude first and then start thinking about becoming a nun?
Sexy nun: What the fuck man?! I went kinda far, but it’s your fault! Can’t you say something nice from time to time?
That’s pretty bad… She got really angry although I didn’t say anything that bad. I need to calm her down.
You: Well…{{wi}} We are at church, so I can’t lie. 
Sexy nun: Hmph! You don’t even know me, so stop being so judgemental! 
You: Listen, if you are really serious about it you are welcome to prove me wrong. 
Sexy nun: I will! Just you wait! 
???: I’m afraid her being a nun is impossible.
